[EN] Reap the Whirlwind
[ES] Cosecha tempestades
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "It's as good as done."
[ES] "Está hecho."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Kill elite orcan combatants, elite Beakrock shamans, and enthralled raiders.
[ES] Mata a combatientes orcan de élite, chamanes de Roca pico de élite y asaltantes subyugados.

[EN] "Consider it done."

Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Find Mirvan near the giant orcan corpse.
[ES] Encuentra a Mirvan cerca del cadáver del orcan gigante.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Seems easy enough."
[ES] "Parece bastante fácil."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Talk to Belgun.
[ES] Habla con Belgun.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Fight your way through enthralled mouldermen, bombers, and explosives handlers.

Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Rahto's Stone Heart
[ES] El corazón de piedra de Rahto
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Kill Rahto and acquire Rahto's stone heart.
[ES] Mata a Rahto y consigue el corazón de piedra de Rahto.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Give Rahto's stone heart to Princess Arin.
[ES] Entrégale el corazón de piedra de Rahto a la princesa Arin.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I was glad to help, princess."
[ES] "Me alegra haber ayudado, princesa."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
